summary.key_theme: 受惠於 AI 需求強勁與記憶體超級週期，Micron 繳出破紀錄的財報表現，並獲得分析師廣泛看好其長期成長潛力。

bullish.title: Micron Beat on Earnings and Guided Above Estimates. How Investors Should Play MU Stock Here.
bullish.reason: Micron 公布第四季財報，每股盈餘達 33.42 美元，營收達 542.3 億美元，雙雙優於預期，顯示 AI 記憶體需求極度強勁。

bullish.title: EXCLUSIVE: Micron’s NAND Revenue Surged 526%: Why AI Data Centers Need So Much Storage
bullish.reason: NAND 營收年增 526 % 至 141 億美元，凸顯 AI 資料中心對高容量儲存的迫切需求，為公司核心成長引擎。

bullish.title: Micron Technology Seen With Increasingly Positive Duration Tone, Capital Returns Outlook, UBS Says
bullish.reason: 瑞銀 (UBS) 指出記憶體週期持續時間將延長，且公司資本回報前景看好，強化投資人信心。

bullish.title: Micron Technology's Strategic Customer Agreements Provide 'Meaningful' Downside Protection, RBC Says
bullish.reason: RBC 指出與客戶簽訂的戰略協議提供了有效的下檔保護，降低了記憶體市場波動帶來的風險。

bullish.title: Micron Analyst Dismisses Supply Glut Fears As AI Memory Crunch Deepens
bullish.reason: 分析師駁斥市場對供應過剩的擔憂，強調 AI 記憶體超級週期帶來的短缺與定價優勢。

bearish.title: Is Micron Stock Cheap Enough to Survive Lower Memory Profits?
bearish.reason: 探討記憶體利潤下滑的可能性，提醒投資人需關注週期性風險，儘管目前估值看似便宜。

neutral.title: Micron Technology’s Buyback Is Tiny Next to Its Cash Pile. Is a Bigger One Coming?
neutral.reason: 分析公司龐大的現金流與庫藏股規模，市場對於資本配置策略持觀望態度。

neutral.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow Futures Inch Higher As Investors Cheer Cooling Yields — GOOGL, MU, MAT, NVDA In Focus
neutral.reason: 受總體經濟環境（美債殖利率冷卻）影響，屬於市場整體情緒波動，非公司個體因素。

neutral.title: Micron Technology vs. Qualcomm: What Revenue Trends Tell Investors About These Tech Companies
neutral.reason: 透過與 Qualcomm 的營收趨勢比較，客觀分析半導體產業內部的分化現象。
